name: Cute
source:
One of the maids of Baron von Rondman's mansion, in which the protagonist works as a migrant. She is the most energetic girl in the mansion, and is regarded as a kind older sister figure by the servants. In addition, her maternal instincts are very strong, making it difficult for her to ignore any younger, fragile boys. For this reason, she is not at all interested in older men.

[translated from [url=http://dl.getchu.com/i/item1000683]Getchu[/url]]
